verdict.rationale: Rainforest is an embedded-payments API platform, so an official CLI is a fair thing to ask about, and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents a REST API, OpenAPI specs, embeddable components, a Platform Portal, SDKs and llms.txt, but no official command-line tool. Those are adjacent developer surfaces, not a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
